description: Starts a funds-moving USDC on Base to BSV swap. speed is the buyer’s explicit choice; standard is the default. Fast mode makes the kit reveal its secret against an unconfirmed BSV lock. If the market maker double-spends that lock, you can lose the swap amount. It is available only when both sides agree and the amount is at most $25; otherwise the swap waits for one BSV confirmation.

amount_in.description: Amount of from_asset in atomic units (decimal string).

deliver_to.description: Optional destination BSV address. Confirmed BSV is swept there automatically.

from_asset.description: Asset to convert into BSV: USDC or BSV (phase 1 supports USDC → BSV only) (not BSV itself)

min_bsv_out.description: Optional minimum BSV output in sats.

quote.description: Optional: a quote object returned by get_quote, to lock its terms (bound to route + pair + amount_in).

speed.description: Optional buyer choice. standard (default) waits for one BSV confirmation. fast permits an unconfirmed-lock reveal only when both sides agree and the amount is at most $25.

name: swap_asset_to_bsv
title: Start USDC to BSV swap
